title: Watch Catalog
description: Brand-neutral catalog of market-independent watch configurations. Schema version 3 uses the brand's complete official reference as the canonical identity source.

sourceMarketCodes.description: Market codes whose collected data have been reconciled with this catalog; this does not assert complete market coverage or availability of every configuration in every market.

watchCount.description: Number of unique watch references; must equal watches.length.

watches.$comment: JSON Schema uniqueItems rejects identical objects, not distinct objects sharing an identity. Validate reference and watchId uniqueness, watchCount equality, and watchId = brandId + ':' + reference separately.
